verdict.rationale: Rainforest's docs have a dedicated reference page (reference/openapi.md) stating it supports OpenAPI Specifications of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0, a machine-readable spec for the API. The probe's 404s were at guessed common paths, not the documented page, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: an explicit documented download URL or file for the spec, independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec can be fetched.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
Rainforest supports [OpenAPI Specifications (OAS)](https://www.openapis.org/) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
